scoring_justification: Recompute |S_T^B| and |S_T^τ| from agent's temperature_scan_results.csv by linear regression of ln(B/B0) and ln(τ/τ0) against T and compare absolute slopes to paper-reported theoretical values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference slopes for temperature sensitivity of modal birefringence and PMD
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper reported theoretical values: |S_T^B| = 3 × 10⁻⁴ °C⁻¹, |S_T^τ| = 7 × 10⁻⁴ °C⁻¹ (Section IV-A, Fig. 3); extracted from paper md.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are the paper's own published theoretical predictions.

outputs.description: Modal birefringence B and polarization mode dispersion τ as functions of ambient temperature (10, 20, 30, 40, 50 °C). The checker recomputes the relative temperature sensitivities |S_T^B| and |S_T^τ| from this file.

output_contract.notes: The agent must write exactly 5 rows (T = 10, 20, 30, 40, 50). The checker reads this CSV, computes ln(B/B₀) and ln(τ/τ₀) with T₀ = 10 °C, performs linear regression against T, takes absolute values of the slopes, and compares them to the paper’s published theoretical sensitivities with absolute tolerances.

steps.description: Recompute |S_T^B| and compare to paper reference 3e-4
